# Health

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(qrspike)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
source("data.R")

health    <- health_data()
sd_trend  <- qr_shared(health, ~code, "gemeente")
sd_latest <- qr_shared(health[health$year == 2024, c("code", "name", "good_health")], ~code, "gemeente")
```

An inline copy of the selector; it must stay in sync with the sidebar.

```{r}
#| echo: false
qr_input("gemeente", choices, label = "Compare municipalities", type = "select")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
plot_ly(sd_trend, x = ~year, y = ~good_health, color = ~name,
        type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
datatable(sd_latest, rownames = FALSE)
```
